name: source-maintainer
body: A person who reads, edits, reviews, and extends the apg source — the root crate and the eight frontend crates. They hold one module in mind at a time, so an oversized source file forces them to scroll past thousands of lines of inline tests to find the unit they meant to change, and duplicated helpers let a change in one place silently diverge from its copies. Their interest is a source tree of small, cohesive, single-purpose modules with no duplicated logic, each with its tests adjacent and its production code accounted separately from its tests.
